summary: Premarket Cold-Start Data Readiness + Release Runtime Ownership: during the first 10 minutes after 04:00 ET, missing/old prior-session data is identified as WAITING_FIRST_PREMARKET_SNAPSHOT rather than a generic feed failure, while Executive Mode remains fail-closed. TAG500 retries every 30 seconds only inside the startup window until a current-session PM snapshot arrives. Release History no longer dynamically injects an older Final Snapshot Authority, eliminating a runtime race/duplicate-authority risk; the entrypoint owns runtime modules and Release History only manages identity/history plus integrity diagnostics. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.
